title: Approve the home composition
question: Marker Zine is locked. Pick the home composition to build against (comp-led). A = decision comp (margin walkthrough). B = comic stack. C = sketchbook spread.

options.label: A — Margin walkthrough
options.thesis: Notes in the margin teach the page; demos live in a browser plate on the right.

options.label: B — Comic stack
options.thesis: Vertical comic panels: hero → experience strip → project demos with arrows.

options.label: C — Sketchbook spread
options.thesis: Open spread: profile notes left, oversized live demo right, contact on the ruled footer.
